id.problem: Mangkok kampas ganda kotor penuh debu, kampas ganda tipis/slip, atau karet dumper aus.
id.action: Jangan langsung ganti part mahal, lakukan servis pembersihan blok CVT rutin.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Mas, tolong servis CVT dan bersihkan mangkok kampas gandanya dari debu.'

en.problem: Dirty clutch housing with dust, slipping clutch pads, or worn damper rubber.
en.action: Do not rush to buy expensive parts, a routine CVT cleaning is enough.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please service the CVT block and clean the clutch housing from dust.'

id.problem: Oli mesin lolos ke ruang bakar karena ring piston baret, silinder aus, atau seal klep bocor.
id.action: Cek rutin volume oli mesin agar tidak kehabisan total di tengah jalan.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Knalpot motor ngebul putih, tolong cek ring piston dan seal klep untuk turun mesin atas.'

en.problem: Engine oil leaking into combustion chamber due to scratched piston rings or leaking valve seals.
en.action: Check engine oil level regularly to avoid running dry.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Exhaust is smoking white, please check piston rings and valve seals for a top overhaul.'

id.problem: Aki drop, atau Bendik Starter (Relay Starter) mengalami konslet/kotor di dalamnya.
id.action: Gunakan kick starter (celah manual) untuk menghidupkan mesin sementara.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek voltase aki, jika normal berarti bendik starter-nya yang rusak, tolong ganti.'

en.problem: Weak battery or shorted/faulty starter relay (bendik).
en.action: Use the kick starter to turn on the engine temporarily.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please check battery voltage, if normal the starter relay is faulty, please replace it.'

symptoms: sudah ganti aki baru tapi tekor lagi
lampu motor makin direv makin redup
id.problem: Kiprok (Regulator/Rectifier) mati, atau spul motor gosong sehingga tidak ada arus pengisian ke aki.
id.action: Batasi penggunaan aksesoris kelistrikan tambahan (seperti lampu sorot) agar aki tidak langsung habis di jalan.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong cek voltase pengisian aki saat digas, apakah kiprok atau spul-nya yang mati.'

en.problem: Faulty regulator/rectifier or burned stator coil preventing battery charging.
en.action: Limit extra electrical accessories like spotlights to prevent fast battery drain.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please check the charging voltage when revving to see if the regulator or stator coil is dead.'

symptoms: motor sering mati mendadak saat berhenti di lampu merah
mesin mbrebet saat gas ditarik dikit
id.problem: Throttle body sangat kotor, sensor IACV kotor/mati, atau setelan klep terlalu rapat.
id.action: Tahan sedikit selongsong gas saat berhenti agar motor tidak mati mendadak.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Motor sering mati saat gas ditutup, tolong bersihkan throttle body, sensor IACV, dan setel ulang klep.'

symptoms: motorcycle frequently stalls when stopping at red lights
en.problem: Very dirty throttle body, dirty/dead IACV sensor, or valve clearance is too tight.
en.action: Keep a slight throttle input when stopping to prevent sudden stalling.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'The bike stalls when closing throttle, please clean the throttle body, IACV sensor, and adjust valves.'

symptoms: oli mesin motor berubah warna jadi keputihan
oli campur air seperti kopi susu
id.problem: Air radiator (coolant) bocor menyeberang masuk ke ruang mesin akibat Seal Waterpump jebol.
id.action: BAHAYA! Jangan nyalakan mesin sama sekali agar komponen dalam (kruk as, bearing) tidak hancur tergerus air.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Oli saya jadi susu putih, tolong ganti seal waterpump satu set dan kuras oli mesin berulang kali (flushing).'

symptoms: oil looks like coffee with milk
en.problem: Coolant leak crossing into the engine crankcase due to a blown water pump seal.
en.action: DANGER! Do not start the engine to prevent total destruction of internal bearings by water.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'The oil is milky white, please replace the water pump seal and flush the engine oil thoroughly multiple times.'

symptoms: mentok nabrak besi saat lewat lubang
bocor keluar oli di as shock
id.problem: Seal shock bocor sehingga oli habis kering, per patah, atau as shock baret/bengkok.
id.action: Kurangi kecepatan secara drastis saat melewati jalan berlubang agar velg motor tidak ikut bengkok.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong bongkar shock depan, cek as-nya, ganti seal shock, dan isi ulang takaran oli shock-nya.'

symptoms: front shock absorbers are extremely stiff
bottoms out hitting metal on potholes
leaking oil on the fork tubes
en.problem: Leaking shock seals draining the oil, broken springs, or scratched/bent shock fork tubes.
en.action: Slow down significantly when riding over potholes to avoid bending the motorcycle rims.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please overhaul the front shocks, check the tubes, replace the seals, and refill the shock oil properly.'

symptoms: gear motor sudah tajam seperti pisau
id.problem: Rantai sudah sangat kendor/mulur, dan mata gear depan-belakang sudah aus meruncing (tajam).
id.action: Jangan berakselerasi spontan. Risiko rantai putus atau lepas dari gear sangat tinggi dan berbahaya.
id.garage_tip: Sampaikan: 'Tolong ganti Gear Set (rantai, gear depan, dan belakang) satu paket ori.'

symptoms: motorcycle chain making loud clicking noise
sprocket teeth are sharp like a knife
en.problem: Chain is severely stretched/loose, and the front and rear sprocket teeth are dangerously worn and sharp.
en.action: Do not accelerate aggressively. There is a high risk of the chain snapping or derailing.
en.garage_tip: Say: 'Please replace the entire chain and sprocket kit (front and rear) as a complete set.'
